text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, as summer camp reached the 
halfway mark—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Tonight, the whispers of the stars ring 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And you... You look as if you could melt 
into this darkness, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How unusual of you to invite me out like 
this. Or did some messenger of fate 
whisper in your ear?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――I have watched you... ――this entire 
time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby— An injury—and the 
comeback from it—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And— The Yasuda Kinen—and the Takarazuka 
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Magnificent, was it? That's—what I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Um... fortitude... challenge... and... 
fanaticism and... destruction, are...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It must have had... an impact... on many 
Umamusume... including myself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— You are quite eloquent with your 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That's all the more reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I must—this time for sure— 
...completely defeat—you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: In order to... fulfill... my "mission"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In the next... Tenno Sho (Autumn)— I 
will...—definitely beat you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ......Heheh. ...Ahahahahaha――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! BWAHAHAHAHA!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Allow me to return the favor in full.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...In order for me to descend anew as the 
'God of Destruction'—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kris S!! You, who have crossed paths with 
me so many times— I must defeat you!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my new raison d'être— I 
will defeat you at the upcoming Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (That's it— I've finally realized it...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...We are each other's destinies... 
beings who share the weight of the exact 
same fated chains—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And... not only that――――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"To me, you are... the one who will 
transcend destiny...—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: So it was an "ordeal."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
............We came to understand each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............Not entirely, however.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. What lies between us—is 
still an abyss.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if I were to wander through tens of 
billions of nights―― filling that abyss 
could never, ever come to pass.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet that is fine. ——That is *precisely* 
how it should be!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We are the same, yet different— That's why 
we clash, why we seek each other out!! And 
push each other to ever greater heights!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —And that made complete sense to me...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—You have my gratitude, Kris S. And I 
shall repay this favor――――with my 
running.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I am the one... who should be thanking 
you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then... I suppose that makes us even.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My great archrival and trial, Symboli Kris 
S—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I swear to this starry sky. I shall 
forever remain your... "Destiny."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: In that case... I, too, shall make a vow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet...... I shall continue to 
be your 'trial'――"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then... It will all be decided at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
At this very moment— to have you 
running... I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if blessing our vow, the stars twinkle, 
and carrying these feelings, the season 
shifts from summer into autumn—
